name: application-empty-states
title: Empty States
description: Task-oriented placeholder screens shown when a view has no content yet, guiding users toward a first meaningful action.
useWhen: A list, table, or workspace has no items yet and users need guidance on how to add their first one.
A search or filter returns zero results and users need a clear explanation and recovery path.
Onboarding users to a feature by showing what the space will look like once populated.
avoidWhen: Content is loading — use a skeleton or spinner instead, not an empty state.
A required error or system failure occurred — use an error page or alert, not an empty state.
The empty condition is temporary and will resolve automatically without user action.
responsiveBehavior: Empty state panels center within their container at all viewport sizes. Illustration and text stack vertically; buttons remain full-width on mobile.
accessibility: Heading text within the empty state should use an appropriate heading level that fits the document outline.
CTA buttons must have clear, descriptive labels that explain what will happen — avoid generic 'Click here'.
File upload drop zones must be keyboard operable with a fallback button trigger.

variants.title: Create first item
variants.description: Centered empty state prompting users to create their first record with an icon, headline, and primary CTA button.
accessibility: CTA button label should specify what will be created, e.g. 'Create your first project'.

variants.title: Create first item (Dark)
variants.description: Create-first-item empty state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Icon, heading, and button colors must maintain WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Import or create
variants.description: Empty state offering two parallel paths — importing existing data or creating from scratch — with equal visual weight.
accessibility: Both action paths should be reachable by keyboard; label each button to distinguish the two actions clearly.

variants.title: Import or create (Dark)
variants.description: Dual-path import-or-create empty state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Both action buttons must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Upload data
variants.description: Empty state with a drag-and-drop file upload zone as the primary call to action for data-ingestion flows.
accessibility: Drop zone must include a keyboard-accessible button fallback so non-mouse users can trigger the file picker.

variants.title: Upload data (Dark)
variants.description: File upload drop-zone empty state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark drop zone border and label colors must remain visible in both default and drag-over states.

variants.title: Get started
variants.description: Onboarding-oriented empty state with feature highlights or steps to guide new users into the product.
accessibility: Onboarding content should follow a logical reading order so screen reader users get the same flow.

variants.title: Get started (Dark)
variants.description: Onboarding-oriented get-started empty state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Step icons and label text must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: No results found
variants.description: Post-search or post-filter empty state explaining that the current query matched nothing, with a way to clear or adjust filters.
accessibility: Announce the empty result state to screen readers with a live region update when the list empties after filtering.

variants.title: No results found (Dark)
variants.description: No-results-found empty state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Icon and text colors must maintain WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
